---
title: "Consulting and Applied Research"
---

Applied economics engagements for multilateral organizations, government institutions
and private firms across Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, Guatemala and Paraguay, ranging from
impact evaluation and reproducibility auditing to regulatory and competition analysis.
